title: Business Analyst I Sydney CBD
text: Business Analyst I Sydney CBD at BANK OF SYDNEY LTD (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Full-Time position based in Sydney CBD and close to public transport Opportunity to build great relationships within your team and other departments within Head Office Work within a Bank, who has received recognition for Money Magazine Award Winner Best of the Best Cheapest Home Loan Package for 2017 & 2018 About The Business Analyst Role This role provides an opportunity for a talented and highly motivated person to work in a dynamic team environment to develop and enhance their skills in Digital Banking. You will play a key role in shaping the future of the Bank's digital capabilities whilst supporting performance driven outcomes. Reporting to the Head of Digital Channel, your key responsibilities will include: Improving and supporting Digital Banking solutions Quality control of new and existing products Contribute to the Digital Channel's annual objectives Coordinate product testing across departments and customer groups Gather and analyse data to identify and assess product enhancement opportunities Discover, analyse, measure and document current and future processes to understand root causes of issues Initiate, facilitate and recommend improvements Conducting market research About You The ideal candidate will have: University Degree in Business, Commerce or IT Have at least 1 year related working experience in the same or similar role Excellent verbal and written skills Great interpersonal skills and a desire to work in a close knit team Strong sense of initiative and self-starter Strong interpersonal and time management skills Accuracy and attention to detail Ability to learn and retain information quickly Microsoft and Excel knowledge Ability to quickly understand complex business issues and processes What We Offer Bank product and service discounts Be more than just a number and part of our Family Free Onsite Gym Huge development and progression opportunities About Us Bank of Sydney has been successfully operating in Australia since 2001. Every day at Bank of Sydney, our team members implement the Bank's vision and mission. We are defined by our professional, friendly and active people who take every opportunity to grow and achieve the Bank's business goals. We aim to fulfil our employees' inspirations in their current roles. That's why we identify their competencies, develop their skills and empower them to achieve their best. We are always looking for passionate and dedicated people to join our dynamic team in various roles and contribute to the success and growth of Bank of Sydney. What is our Vision? To be Australia's only true relationship Bank What is our Mission? To grow together with our customers and our people through personal relationships and premium service To join our growing bank where people and relationships matter, apply now!
